text:
Mia: Starting thread — decision needed on lifting the runtime pin for canary group A. Deploybot started a phased canary yesterday.

deploybot: Started canary rollout: runtime-v3.2 -> 5% traffic on hosted-eu-west at 4219876543

Sam: Telemetry looks OK for token throughput, but we're seeing a small error spike in the routing layer around 4219876558 :eyes:

Julia: Can you paste the logs? might be SDK binding mismatch with plugin v1.4.2

Sam: logs snippet:
```
[router] 2026-02-12T14:16:xxZ ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream_error=kv-cache-timeout
```

Sam: Not huge but +1.8% 5m error rate for that canary shard. 95th latency up ~350ms.

Henry: Thresholds we agreed: rollback if error_rate > 2% OR p95 > 1200ms OR token-failures > 0.5%. We're under p95 limit but error_rate creeping close. My vote: hold the unpin; run targeted regression tests.

Mia: Agreed. Hold unpin. We need a rollback/playbook in case it worsens. Who can run a quick prompt-set eval? Julia?

Julia: I'll run evals on the canary prompt set and a few long-seq cases. ETA ~15m.

opsbot: Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/canary-rollback — steps 1..6

Mia: Plan proposal:
- keep runtime pinned for the affected model group
- increase canary to 25% only if telemetry stable for 30m
- if error_rate crosses 2% or p95 > 1200ms rollback to runtime-v3.1
- notify customers via status page if rollback occurs

Sam: +1. Also add automatic fallback policy to route to model-variant: llama3q-small for latency-sensitive routes.

Mia: Add that to deploybot config. Example route override:
```
route_policy:
  - priority: latency
    fallback: llama3q-small
```

deploybot: Noted. Can create a soft-rollout with pinbackoff window 30m. Will not unpin until manual ACK from release lead.

Henry: If we need to rollback, follow runbook step 3 and run `deploybot rollback --to runtime-v3.1 --canary-id 20260212A` then monitor 5m windows.

Mia: Thanks. Julia — ping here with eval summary. Sam — keep an eye on error sources (routing vs model). I'll hold the unpin PR.

Julia: Eval summary: no semantic regressions, but cache-timeout repeats on long-seq >2048 tokens in 4/200 cases. Risk is bounded but visible.

Mia: Ok that's enough to keep pin. Let's wait for 4h of stable telemetry before re-open unpin. Marking this thread as decision: HOLD UNPIN. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary paused at 5% by release lead hold. Audit: action=user_hold reason="cache-timeout" id=4219876543

Mia: I'll write up notes for release notes and post a short blurb in product channel after lunch.

Henry: I'll prepare rollback cmds and checkpoint snapshots just in case.

Sam: thanks all — will follow up with root cause triage once we have more logs.
